provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench held-out evaluation fixture, authored 2026-10-24 before any training data. Final-model evaluation only; never shown to training-data generation.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Modify sections/hero-cta.liquid to add an optional call-to-action link after the h2, inside the existing section. Inputs: section.id and section.settings.heading are strings; section.settings.cta_label and section.settings.cta_url are null or strings. Emit one a class=button only when both the ASCII-trimmed label and the ASCII-trimmed url are nonempty; its href is the trimmed url and its text the trimmed label. Preserve the existing section class, data-id and heading with their escaping. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/hero-cta.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
